decision_conditions: Acquire Tardis derivatives/perpetual historical CSV access covering the selected start through 2026-06-30.
Acquire raw replay access if historical instrument_info messages are needed for lifecycle-grade A/B reconstruction.
Run frozen gates on the purchased, cutoff-filtered capture before any R1 execution.
Treat every exposed GRADE_C/GRADE_X terminal as BLOCKED_BY_DATA_INTEGRITY.

tardis.limitation: availableTo means recorder stop and can lag exchange delisting

coin_metrics.limitation: historical endpoints/catalogs require API key; catalog min/max is not an exchange lifecycle event

kaiko.limitation: documented endpoints require client API key; contract detail coverage and lifecycle retention were not publicly proven for Bybit

bybit.limitation: linear default returns Trading instruments; current response is not historical inventory

free_sample.result: gzip-valid normalized derivative ticker capture; raw rate format and funding timestamp present; does not itself prove realized settlement

graveyard_test.population_rule: Tardis Bybit perpetual symbols ending USDT; selected by lifecycle class only, never by strategy outcome
graveyard_test.terminal_grade: GRADE_C unless an independently timestamped official event is bound during procurement

future_reservoir.rule: all subsequent extraction filters event and observation timestamps at or before cutoff
